rationale: Retain Advanced Power as an active ArcLight infrastructure portfolio company while correcting the existing record rather than adding a duplicate owner. The census manager name ArcLight Capital and the database owner ArcLight Capital Partners refer to the same manager. ArcLight announced the transaction on July 24, 2025, but its September 2025 ESG report said Fund VIII's acquisition remained subject to closing conditions. The PJM Independent Market Monitor records February 12, 2026 as the consummation date for ArcLight's acquisition of 100% of Advanced Power US Holdings, Inc., the controlling U.S. entity, under FERC docket EC25-123. ArcLight's April 2026 Fund VIII release continues to identify Advanced Power as a backed thermal-power development team. The exact percentage acquired in the broader branded platform is not publicly disclosed, and no Advanced Power-specific exit or pending sale was found through August 12, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Advanced Power
beforeImage.description: Advanced Power develops, constructs, and manages large-scale power generation and storage projects. Its end markets are wholesale electricity systems, utilities, and capacity markets, and the business follows an asset-heavy development model centered on permitting, engineering, interconnection, procurement, and project financing. ArcLight stated in 2025 that Advanced Power had developed more than 6 GW historically and had a pipeline of more than 12 GW of new thermal and renewable projects plus more than 10 GWh of storage. The company operates from U.S. offices including Boston and Houston and functions as a development platform rather than a single-asset owner. ArcLight announced in July 2025 that it had acquired Advanced Power and committed $1 billion of equity to support further development, while public sources do not disclose the resulting ownership percentage.

afterImage.name: Advanced Power
afterImage.description: Advanced Power is a Boston-based developer, financial structurer, owner and asset manager of utility-scale natural-gas, solar, wind and battery-storage projects. Founded in 2000, the platform develops and manages projects through permitting, interconnection, financing, construction and operations, with U.S. offices in Boston and Houston. At ArcLight's July 2025 announcement, Advanced Power reported 6 GW of completed thermal and renewable projects, a late-stage U.S. pipeline exceeding 12 GW and more than 10 GWh of storage projects. ArcLight Infrastructure Partners Fund VIII completed its acquisition of 100% of Advanced Power US Holdings, Inc., the controlling U.S. entity, on February 12, 2026; the exact percentage acquired in the broader branded platform is not publicly disclosed.
